subject: Post-remediation delta validation and attestation request — FinServ Inc.
messages:
From: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@finserv.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-remediation validation request and delta attestation (FinServ PT)

Hi Marcus / team,

Thanks for the remediation note you sent earlier this week. FinServ completed the independent penetration test in April and received your remediation summary — appreciate the quick turnaround. Before we close our engagement we need: a scoped delta validation (limited retest of previously exploited issues), and an updated attestation/delta report for our records (SOC 2 evidence package).

Request: can you provide
- a short remediation summary (what was changed, CVE or issue IDs addressed),
- a stable window for a 3–4 hour delta validation (we prefer next-week windows), and
- a DocuSign-ready attestation or instruction on how we should capture signoff after validation.

Please attach a short evidence bundle index (checksums, screenshots, runbook excerpts) and any Jira ticket IDs that map to fixes. We will scope the retest to the delta list only (no full-scope retest) and produce a delta findings addendum and attestation letter after we verify.

Attachment: remediation_plan_v2.pdf (for your reference)

If you prefer a quick sync instead of email, propose 30 minutes and we’ll set it up.

Thanks,
Alice Zhou
Security Program Manager
FinServ Inc.
alice.zhou@finserv.com
--
Attachment: remediation_plan_v2.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@finserv.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-remediation validation request and delta attestation (FinServ PT)

Thanks Alice — appreciate the clarity.

Quick summary from our side:
- Root cause: exposed admin endpoint with lax auth (issue ID: PT-2027-102).
- Fixes applied: rate-limiting + auth hardening + token rotation; mitigations deployed to prod on 2027-06-14 at 03:00 UTC.
- Artifacts attached: patches-checksum.txt (checksums for the deployed artifacts) and deployment-runbook.pdf (runbook excerpt showing rollback steps).

Jira mapping: SUP-4882 (authentication hardening), SUP-4890 (token rotation).

We are available for a delta validation window on the following options (PST):
- Tue 2027-06-22, 09:00–13:00
- Wed 2027-06-23, 12:00–16:00

For the attestation: we can either sign a short delta attestation after you confirm the retest results, or you can send a DocuSign template and we’ll populate it. We prefer DocuSign for auditability.

If you plan to run active exploit attempts against the fix, please share the exact tests you will run and we’ll schedule an on-call engineering contact (will be me and Neha).

On Thu, Jun 17, 2027 at 09:15 AM Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@finserv.com> wrote:

Marcus Lin

Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: patches-checksum.txt (TXT, 2 KB)
Attachment: deployment-runbook.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

From: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@finserv.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-remediation validation request and delta attestation (FinServ PT)

Marcus — thanks for the quick details and the artifacts. Confirming we will run a delta validation focused on PT-2027-102 and related auth flows only. That will include: credential brute force scenarios, token replay, and session fixation checks (no social engineering).

We can take the Tue 2027-06-22 09:00–13:00 PST window. Please ensure an engineer is on call for the first hour and available on chat for the remainder.

I will send a DocuSign attestation template during the retest day; once we complete validation we will issue a delta findings addendum and a signed attestation letter for your SOC 2 file.

Also, please upload a compact evidence index (checksums + one screenshot per fix) to the shared drive prior to the test. That speeds our verification.

Attestation/doc instructions attached: attestation_request.docx

Best,
Alice Zhou
Security Program Manager
FinServ Inc.
--
Attachment: attestation_request.docx (DOCX, 48 KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@finserv.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-remediation validation request and delta attestation (FinServ PT)

Alice — confirmed. We’ve scheduled the delta validation for Tue 2027-06-22 09:00–13:00 PST and will have Marcus (on-call lead) and Neha (engineer) available the first hour and on Slack for the remainder.

Pre-test checklist (short):
- Shared drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/finserv/sup-4882/evidence (please confirm access)
- Evidence index: evidence_bundle_index.csv (attached) — includes checksum + screenshot references for each fix
- Point of contact during test: Marcus Lin (mobile: +1 415 555 0123)
- DocuSign template: we will accept your template; please send link on test day

If you need us to disable any mitigations for testing (rate limits), call out exact endpoints/tests and we will create a temporary rule. Otherwise we will keep protections in place and provide logs as requested.

Looking forward to closing this out.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
--
Attachment: evidence_bundle_index.csv (CSV, 7 KB)
